title: Croatia sets out €932 million plan for artificial intelligence development
script:
Nine hundred thirty two million euros. That is Croatia's massive new plan for AI.
Croatia Week reported the funding will boost research capacity and digital innovation.
The national strategy focuses on building language tools tailored for the Croatian language.
Developers plan to create a specialized large language model for local public administration use.
Would you trust a public administration run by a local language model?
